purpose: Independently test whether accounting for both token and Top-K slot consumption removes the short-fragment bias of v35 without tuning on revealed RGB outcomes.

hypothesis_origin.observed_v35_failure: Marginal-utility-per-token selection usually exhausted five slots while leaving much of the token budget unused, reducing support precision and recall.

source.name: MuSiQue: Multihop Questions via Single-hop Question Composition
source.all_rows_policy: Use every structurally valid dev row; do not sample or replace rows after outcomes are known.
source.post_download_registration: Before neural scoring, record the archive/file hashes, exact row count, exclusions, hop distribution, duplicate-label conflicts, paragraph and chunk distributions.

frozen_adapter.answerable_policy: Require answerable=true because the frozen file is MuSiQue-Answerable; any false row is a structural exclusion.
frozen_adapter.candidate_text: Normalized title + newline + normalized paragraph_text, omitting an empty title without a leading newline.
frozen_adapter.candidate_order: Deduplicate normalized candidate text, union paragraph indices/support labels, sort by text SHA-256, then assign label-neutral source and chunk IDs.
frozen_adapter.cross_label_duplicate_policy: Exclude a case if identical normalized candidate text is both supporting and non-supporting.
frozen_adapter.gold_unit: Each unique supporting paragraph idx is one required support unit; every chunk of that source paragraph inherits the unit.
frozen_adapter.structural_exclusion_policy: Exclude only invalid field types, empty question, non-answerable rows, no supporting paragraph, fewer than two unique candidates, cross-label duplicate conflicts, or duplicate public IDs; report all reasons without replacement.

role_queries.direct_answer_support: Find evidence that directly supports a correct answer to the question.
role_queries.entity_and_scope: Find evidence that identifies the relevant entity, scope, time, or conditions for the answer.
role_queries.corroborating_evidence: Find independent evidence that corroborates or completes the answer.
role_queries.contradiction_detection: Find evidence useful for detecting conflicting, false, or misleading claims about the answer.

frozen_dual_resource_selector.set_objective: F(S) = 2 * mean_over_roles(max role_score in S) + sum_over_selected(cross_encoder_score)
frozen_dual_resource_selector.greedy_rule: Repeatedly select the feasible candidate with maximum marginal_F / normalized_resource_cost; break ties by larger marginal_F, larger cross-encoder score, lower token_count, then ascending candidate_id.
frozen_dual_resource_selector.singleton_guard: Compare the greedy set with every feasible singleton under F(S); return the alternative with larger F, then lower token cost, then lexicographically smaller selected-ID tuple.
frozen_dual_resource_selector.derivation: The two addends are the candidate's fractions of the two independent packing resources. Equal normalized pressure introduces no dataset-fitted coefficient and prevents a tiny token cost from making a scarce slot effectively free.
frozen_dual_resource_selector.hard_constraints: sum token_count <= budget and selected count <= top_k

frozen_metrics.support_precision: selected chunks from supporting source paragraphs / selected chunks
frozen_metrics.support_recall: unique supporting paragraph units with any selected chunk / all supporting paragraph units
frozen_metrics.support_evidence_f1: harmonic mean of support_precision and support_recall, with zero when both are zero
frozen_metrics.family_aggregation: Mean within budget first, then equal weight across 512/1024/1500 budgets.

stopping_rule.gate_policy: This cross-domain selector experiment cannot by itself change Gate 2, authorize CANARY/DEFAULT, reproduce SetR, or establish flood-domain effectiveness.
